journey.name: scan onchain amount over hardware spendable
journey.description: Verifies that an on-chain BIP21 request whose amount a paired hardware wallet's balance covers, but not once the network fee is taken, shows the Insufficient Savings toast and closes the Send sheet, instead of leaving the Confirm screen on the hardware wallet with a Try again toast and a disabled swipe. Nothing is broadcast. Precondition: an onboarded dev wallet with 0 sats in Savings and a paired Bridge emulator (see README.md) whose native-segwit account holds a confirmed regtest balance B of at least 10 000 sats, read from its home tile. Use an amount between B minus 100 sats and B, which the balance covers but the balance minus any non-zero fee does not, and a regtest address the wallet does not own. Start on the wallet home screen. iOS opens the Confirm screen (id "SendConfirm") while it checks the funding sources, so the sheet may show briefly before it closes; Android shows the toast without opening Confirm.

actions.action: Read the paired Trezor's balance B from its home tile (id "ActivityHardware") and pick an amount A with B - 100 < A < B, written in BTC

Verify within 30 seconds the Insufficient Savings toast (id "InsufficientSavingsToast") appears (screenshot), the Send sheet closes back to the wallet home screen, and no "Please try again" toast is shown
Pick an amount below B by at least 2 000 sats and run the same openurl command with it

Verify the Confirm screen opens with the Trezor as the funding source (Show Details, id "SendConfirmAssetButton"), a non-zero network fee and an enabled swipe (id "GRAB"); close the sheet without sending
